analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lyon (13th, 7 points) have been led by caretaker Jorge Maciel since Paulo Fonseca left for Sporting CP, and drew 1-1 at Real Sociedad last time out in Europe after three straight away defeats. Lillestrom are 34th with one point and two goals in four games, including a 6-0 home defeat by Real Sociedad.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. Lyon have been solid in Ligue 1 and Lillestrom have conceded ten goals in four games, so a comfortable home win fits. Lillestrom have scored only twice, which limits how high the total goes, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.8 corners, nearly eight of them for Lyon. A one-sided home game against one of the competition's weakest sides fits a high corner count, and Lillestrom's habit of defending deep should keep it there.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. One-sided matches tend to bring fewer bookings, and neither side has had disciplinary trouble in this league phase, so I stay with a low count.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots. Lyon should dominate and Lillestrom's defence has been opened up repeatedly, so a high total fits, though a caretaker-led Lyon can be uneven.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.3 shots on target. Real Sociedad scored six at Lillestrom, which shows how many clear chances they can allow, and Lyon, who forced a 90th-minute save from Tolisso's header in San Sebastian, should find them too.
